title: 彭博智库Mandy Deep：AI交易逆转，波动性产品单日抛售450亿美元
speaker: Mandy Deep

segments.en: When the price action starts to roll over, as we saw this week, these things generate very, very substantial flows.
segments.zh: 当价格走势开始反转，就像本周我们看到的那样，这些产品会产生非常巨大的资金流动。

segments.en: I think on Wednesday, the estimate is that they contributed something like $45 billion of selling into the close.
segments.zh: 据估计，周三这些产品在收盘前贡献了约450亿美元的抛售。

segments.en: This is a new development, and so far as the assets under management of these things is exploded, as the AI trade has driven prices up, and it's reminiscent of what we saw in early 2018.
segments.zh: 这是一个新情况，随着AI交易推高价格，这些产品的管理规模已经爆炸式增长，这让人想起2018年初的情形。

segments.en: when volatility-based, exchange-traded notes blew up the market temporarily in early February.
segments.zh: 当时基于波动性的交易所交易票据在2月初暂时冲击了市场。

segments.en: Our colleague is rightly writing about what you're just talking about there, Cameron, saying what the route showed us here is how to expose the machinery of modern speculation, how quickly it can work in reverse.
segments.zh: 我们的同事正在撰文讨论你刚才提到的问题，指出这次下跌展示了现代投机机制如何暴露，以及它反转的速度有多快。
